questions.stem: Metadata Management is described as a key component of which two things?
questions.explanation: Metadata Management is one of the key components of Data Strategy and Data Management.

questions.stem: Are Metadata and Active Metadata two different things?
options: Yes, Active Metadata has a different structure
Yes, Active Metadata is only for unstructured data
No, in reality there is no difference between passive and active Metadata itself
Yes, Active Metadata replaces Technical Metadata
Yes, Active Metadata is stored outside the organisation
questions.explanation: In reality there is no difference between traditional or passive Metadata and Active Metadata; the difference lies in how they are generated and managed.

questions.stem: Where does the real difference between active and passive Metadata lie?
options: In the type of database used to store them
In whether they describe business or technical facts
In the size of the metadata records
In whether they are owned by IT or by the business
In how they are generated and managed
questions.explanation: The difference is in how active and passive metadata are generated and managed, not in what they are.

options: Manually by data stewards in a glossary
Once a year during an audit
Automatically and continuously by systems or tools
Only when a report is published
questions.explanation: As the name says, active metadata is generated automatically and continuously by systems or tools.

questions.stem: Which systems approach is named as a user of Active Metadata?
questions.explanation: Active Metadata is used by systems approaches like Data Fabric, which is explained as a separate topic.

questions.stem: In the analogy of a data solution as a body, what is the Data Fabric?
questions.explanation: Data Fabric is the BRAIN, whereas the rest of the data components are parts of the body in a data solution.

questions.stem: What does the BRAIN of a data solution need, in the Active Metadata analogy?
options: Continuous input and to know everything at the right time, dynamically
A single annual snapshot of metadata
A separate copy of all raw data
questions.explanation: The BRAIN needs continuous input and needs to know everything at the right time, or rather all the time, dynamically.

questions.stem: How is the term Active Metadata characterised?
options: As a new term or jargon surfacing nowadays
As a synonym for Master Data
questions.explanation: Active Metadata is described as a new term or jargon surfacing nowadays, though in reality it is not different from traditional Metadata.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT true of Active Metadata?
options: It is generated automatically by systems or tools
It feeds approaches such as Data Fabric
It is fundamentally a different kind of metadata from passive metadata
It is a new term in the Data World
questions.explanation: Active Metadata is not fundamentally different from passive metadata; only its generation and management differ.

questions.stem: What is traditional metadata called in contrast with Active Metadata?
questions.explanation: Traditional metadata is referred to as passive metadata in contrast with active metadata.
